about_the_game:
Welcome to Lustra, a fractured floating island realm where ancient magic and mystery intertwine. In this immersive experience, you embody Lachea, a young sorceress-in-training whose journey weaves personal growth with community leadership.

The game seamlessly blends exploration, city-building, and character development in a world teeming with enigmatic artefacts and mystical beings. You'll navigate the delicate balance between personal quests and the welfare of your fledgling settlement, facing decisions that echo the complexities of real life.

Explore

Venture through uncharted territories, unraveling puzzles and unearthing rare resources as you search for your missing sister. Each step of your expedition shapes Lachea's character, honing her magical prowess and leadership skills.

Discover the story of Lachea

Through its unique blend of RPG and city-building elements, Lustra challenges players to consider diverse perspectives and make meaningful choices. As you guide Lachea through her personal odyssey and community leadership, you'll not only shape the destiny of a magical realm but also cultivate real-world skills of empathy, self-awareness, and ethical decision-making.

Develop the Settlement|

You'll build and manage a thriving community, making strategic choices about resource allocation, building placement, and citizen roles. Watch your settlement grow and become self-sustained.

Create bonds and Friendships

Interact with a diverse cast of deeply crafted characters presenting moral dilemmas and struggling with difficulties. As you help residents overcome their challenges, you'll confront your own biases and develop empathy and problem-solving skills. The caring Arta serves as your guide, offering advice as you navigate crises and make impactful decisions that ripple through your community, and the talkative Alexander will always serve you with advice.

Become a master sorceress

Combat poses another layer of challenge, with dynamic, spell-driven encounters against magical creatures and formidable foes. These fast paced battles demand adaptability, strategic thinking and dexterity.

  • Graphics: RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
